python3 << 'PYEOF'
import re

with open('test/reports.test.js', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Remove all "const r = require('../src/reports.js');" lines
content = re.sub(r"\n  const r = require\('\.\.\/src\/reports\.js'\);\n", "\n", content)

# Replace all "const reports = require" lines  
content = re.sub(r"\n  const reports = require\('\.\.\/src\/reports\.js'\);", "", content)

# Replace "r.lateFee" with "lateFee"
content = re.sub(r"r\.lateFee", "lateFee", content)

# Replace "reports.lateFee" with "lateFee"
content = re.sub(r"reports\.lateFee", "lateFee", content)

with open('test/reports.test.js', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Fixed!")
PYEOF
